text: Managing a team is a challenging but rewarding responsibility. Good communication is the foundation of success, so leaders should share information clearly and listen to their team members. Delegation is equally important; trusting people with tasks helps them grow and keeps the workload balanced. Regular feedback, both positive and constructive, allows employees to improve and feel valued. Motivation comes from recognising effort and celebrating achievements together. Finally, when disagreements arise, a good leader addresses conflict resolution calmly and fairly, finding solutions that satisfy everyone. By combining these skills, managers can build a strong, motivated team that works well together.
